title: Hardcore Revival Beacon
description: ⚡Revive Beacon: Save friends in Hardcore! Place the block to revive. A GUI checks spectator status & teleports the owner to spawn. Features owner-only mining protection & achievements for the helper and the savior!
body:
⚡ Revive Beacon: Helping Hand
Death is no longer the end. Revive Beacon introduces a powerful, mystical artifact to Minecraft that defies the laws of mortality. Designed for Hardcore enthusiasts and multiplayer survival, this mod offers a high-stakes way to pull your allies back from the void.

✨ Features:
The Ritual of Placement: When the Beacon is placed, the sky itself reacts. A powerful lightning strike marks the spot, binding the soul of the placer to the block.

Soul-Bound Protection: A Beacon is a personal lifeline. Due to its mystical nature, it is bound to its creator. Only the person who placed the Beacon has the power to dismantle it, keeping it safe from those who would wish to see you stay in the shadows.

The Awakening Interface: By interacting with the block, a unique interface appears. The Beacon hums with energy, sensing the state of its owner across dimensions.

The Great Return: If the owner’s spirit is drifting in Spectator Mode, a savior can activate the Beacon. This surge of energy teleports the fallen player back to the World Spawn, restoring their physical form and setting them back into Survival Mode.

Eternal Recognition: Acts of salvation do not go unnoticed.

The savior is honored with the "Helping Hand" achievement. 🤝

The returned is marked by the "Reviver" achievement. ✨

🛠️ How to use:
Craft the mysterious Beacon Recipe:![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4d4b410b0f7be642c6738050e5d4f96d11cbb868.png)

Place it carefully. The lightning will confirm the bond is set.

Wait. Should you fall, your Beacon remains as a beacon of hope.

Resurrect. Once a friend uses the Beacon to bring you back, the block shatters, its energy spent.
